Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football | HP News 9 | National GPL 2026/2027: Kotoko drop points after goalless draw against Gold Stars Source : JoySports 15 November 2026 7:25pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Asante Kotoko were held to a goalless draw by Bibiani Gold Stars in their Week 11 Ghana Premier League clash at the Baba Yara Sports Stadium.
The Porcupine Warriors were hoping to mark their return to the Baba Yara Stadium with a victory following their defeat to Berekum Chelsea in their previous outing.
However, despite their efforts, Kotoko failed to find the breakthrough against a resilient Gold Stars side.
The result extends Kotoko’s winless run to four matches, leaving them 11th on the league table.
Gold Stars, meanwhile, remain two points behind Kotoko in 12th place.
